forecast_text: Oversized stays the main coat shape for AW27 but moves to structured, shoulder-led cuts. UK peak is around the next 4-5 weeks and decline starts in early 2027, so taper AW27 volumes and keep it to a minority of the coat range.
US led the UK by about ten weeks and is already easing; by AW27 oversized is replenishment only in the US.
Quiet luxury is in decline, with search down about 50% from peak. Premium basics survive as a quality position but the understated styling cue fades over the next 9-12 months to mid 2027.
Bold maximalism (colour, print, statement texture) replaces quiet luxury over the next 12-18 months, peaking around mid 2027 and lasting into 2028.
Chocolate brown is the lead AW27 colour: early in its cycle, peaking early 2027. Safe for coats, knitwear and tailoring and strongly relevant to Premium Loyalists.
Butter yellow is past peak and fading fast; use only as an accent colour.
Boucle and textured knits keep growing through AW27 and suit the Premium Loyalists customer.
Recycled wool blends are early in the cycle and a differentiator for Conscious Shoppers; low volume now, growing into 2028.
Wide-leg tailoring keeps growing and peaks around January 2027; core silhouette for AW27 trousers.
Oversized peaks in autumn 2026 and begins to decline in early 2027; fitted alternatives emerge for SS27.
Wellness and recovery stays strong through the holiday season and into 2027, with a long runway to 2029.
Japandi keeps a steady structural climb and peaks around mid 2027.
Dopamine decor is a fad: peaks within weeks and falls away sharply by spring 2027. Test only, do not commit volume.
Sleep sanctuary is early in its cycle and keeps growing into 2028.
Dopamine decor is already past peak in Germany, which led the UK by about 12 weeks.
